# REL001 release-without-cut

A product release tag that `frob release cut` did not create, or that no longer matches its cut.

## What it does

A product tag is a tag name matching the configured `[release] tag` pattern for
one of the configured `[release] products` (default: `v{version}` for one product
named after the repository; this repository sets `{product}-v{version}` for frob
and grimble). The rule fires for each such tag when no recorded `cut` event names
the tag with the same tag object and commit (a tag made by plain `git tag`), when
the tag now points at a different commit than the one the cut recorded (a moved
tag), or when the workspace version in the `Cargo.toml` committed at the tagged
commit differs from the tag's version. Tags that match no product tag are
ignored. A repository with no product tags and no recorded cuts is not
applicable.

## Why it matters

Releases are cut by `frob release cut VERSION`, which tags every shipped binary and records the cut; a tag made any other way cannot be audited.

## Remedy

For a stray tag that is already published, run `frob release adopt VERSION`: it
records the existing tags as the version's cut without touching git or the
remote. For one that is not published, delete it and run `frob release cut
VERSION`. For a moved tag, restore it to the commit the cut recorded. For a
version mismatch, delete the tag and cut the release again.

## Examples

### A violating case fires

```rust expect=fire file=src/lib.rs
pub fn placeholder() {}
```

### A conforming case is clean

```rust expect=clean file=src/lib.rs
pub fn placeholder() {}
```

## Examples

### REL001 release without cut / A tag made by plain tag creation fires #1 (line 11) (fire)

```text
commit 0.0.1
tag frob-v0.0.1
```

### REL001 release without cut / A grimble tag with no recorded cut fires #2 (line 18) (fire)

```text
commit 0.2.0
tag grimble-v0.2.0
```

### REL001 release without cut / A tag whose version differs from the committed workspace version fires #3 (line 25) (fire)

```text
commit 0.0.9
cut frob-v0.1.0 0.1.0
```

### REL001 release without cut / A tag made and recorded by release cut is clean #4 (line 32) (clean)

```text
commit 0.532.0
cut frob-v0.532.0 0.532.0
cut grimble-v0.532.0 0.532.0
```

### REL001 release without cut / The v1 release tag matches no product prefix and is ignored #5 (line 40) (clean)

```text
commit 0.531.0
tag v0.531.0
```
